label: Wire nodes
subgoals: Count n plus 1 channels in each direction
Multiply by W tracks and n over L wires per track
Double for horizontal and vertical channels

label: Pin, source and sink nodes
subgoals: Count one IPIN per input and one OPIN per output
Add one SOURCE and one shared SINK per block
Sum block nodes and wire nodes

label: Edges
subgoals: Count Fc_in W edges into each input pin
Count Fc_out W edges out of each output pin
Multiply the per-block total by the number of blocks
